No Google Cloud project ID found.
BigQuery requires a Google Cloud project ID for billing.
Setup (5 minutes, no credit card needed):
  1. Install gcloud: https://cloud.google.com/sdk/docs/install
  2. Run: gcloud auth login
  3. Run: gcloud auth application-default login --project YOUR_PROJECT_ID
  4. Or set env var: GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=your-project-id
